# 翻譯包｜發佈外部來源

打包翻譯專案的內容目錄，更新 latest Release 供其他翻譯包作為外部來源

- **檔案**：[`.github/workflows/TranslationPack-Publish-Source.yml`](../.github/workflows/TranslationPack-Publish-Source.yml)
- **分類**：翻譯包

## Permissions

| 權限 | 等級 |
| --- | --- |
| `contents` | `write` |

## Inputs

| 名稱 | 型別 | 必填 | 預設 | 說明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `asset_name` | `string` | ✅ | — | Release 檔名，只接受英數字、底線、連字號、加號與點；必須以 ``.zip`` 結尾，不得以點開頭或以 ``.next.zip`` 結尾，例如 ``MMLP-CN-to-ZW.zip`` |
| `project_path` | `string` | — | `.` | 翻譯專案根目錄路徑，打包其 ``Translation/`` 下的內容目錄 |
| `runs_on` | `string` | — | `ubuntu-26.04-arm` | 執行環境，預設為 ``ubuntu-26.04-arm`` |

## Outputs

_無_

## Secrets

_無_

## 使用範例

```yaml
jobs:
  call:
    permissions:
      contents: write
    uses: TeamKugimiya/reusable-workflows/.github/workflows/TranslationPack-Publish-Source.yml@v1
    with:
      asset_name: <值>
```
